criteria.text: `select{x,y}` picks the detection containing the click (smallest area if nested); if none, the nearest detection whose center is within a configurable radius; otherwise responds with `idle` + `error{code:"no_target"}`.
Lock is exclusive: a new person entering or standing near the target never takes over the ID.
Tracks through short detection dropouts (Kalman predict) and brief occlusion; emits `tracking` with the last good geometry flagged by `conf`.

On loss beyond `reacquireMs`, emits `lost`; attempts reacquire only with an appearance check (e.g. color-histogram similarity against the locked crop, stored **in memory only**) above a threshold; otherwise stays `lost` until timeout ⇒ `idle`.
`cancel` clears all lock state and memory of the target appearance immediately.
Geometry is smoothed only lightly (the app owns the control filter) and always normalized; `frameTs` is that of the frame it was derived from.
Tracker library license (MIT/Apache/BSD) recorded; AGPL/GPL dependencies are not added without a recorded decision.
